claim: The automatic startup sweep deletes every media file whose canonical path doesn't exactly match a DB row, with no dry run or safety threshold, so a moved or re-rooted data dir loses all media irreversibly.

Stored paths are absolute canonical strings from allocate_path. There is no dry run, no safety threshold (e.g. abort if most files look orphaned) and no backup before an irreversible bulk delete.
